# Framer Motion Setup in Claude Code

When configuring AI coding workflows, integrating project-level skills ensures consistent animation patterns across the codebase.

## Configuration Steps

1. Create directory structure: `.claude/skills/framer-motion/`
2. Add the skill definition: `SKILL.md` (See [[Framer Motion Skill Rules]])
3. Verify directory contents using Obsidian back-links.
